indian_cctv_heldout_benchmark.name: Untouched Independent Indian Urban CCTV Benchmark
indian_cctv_heldout_benchmark.temporal_buffer: >100 frame ID spacing against all train/val sets
indian_cctv_heldout_benchmark.provenance_limitations: Camera station IDs not provided in official IISc AIM metadata; image and frame disjointness 100% verified.

balanced_multisource_training_mix.name: Arm C Balanced Multi-Source Training Mix

sampling_policy.coco_general: 100% of COCO training images (1,657) to anchor horizontal street perspective
sampling_policy.coco_motorcycle_reinforcement: 1x duplication of 497 motorcycle-containing COCO images to prevent overhead CCTV bias
sampling_policy.uvh26_indian_cctv: Stratified selection of 700 images (566 truck-focused + 134 bus-focused) to improve commercial vehicle recall
sampling_policy.visdrone_aerial: 100% of VisDrone supplement images (345) to train small/distant vehicle detection
